name: Industrial Fabrics, Inc.
old_description: Since 1981, Industrial Fabrics has proudly served many diverse clients in the construction, industrial and residential industries along the Gulf Coast and around the world.
about:
Industrial Fabrics, Inc. (IFI) was founded in 1981 in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, as a manufacturer and distributor of geosynthetic solutions for infrastructure projects. The company pioneered the geosynthetic industry along the Gulf Coast and has since expanded its reach worldwide.

IFI produces a portfolio of branded geosynthetic systems including RockGuard pipeline protection mesh, GrassGuard turf reinforcement, EnviroTubes dewatering and containment tubes, GreenSolutions erosion control blankets, and BaseLok soil stabilization geogrids and GeoCell systems. Operating from a new $8 million production facility, the company offers full-service manufacturing, custom fabrication, design assistance, material logistics, and on-site technical support. To date, IFI has supported over 5,000 projects across more than 20 states and maintains over 10 strategic product brands.

The company serves a broad range of sectors: commercial and industrial development, roadways and highways, railways and mass transit, energy and utility infrastructure (including wind turbine pads and solar farm access roads), residential development, coastal and marine waterways, ports and intermodal facilities, airports, data centers, electrical distribution, petrochemical and chemical plants, oil and gas facilities, government and public works, waste management and containment, military and defense applications, mining, and temporary housing. Customers include engineers, contractors, and government agencies worldwide.

IFI differentiates itself through its on-staff registered engineers who provide design assistance, material selection, and installation guidance; ISO-certified manufacturing with rigorous testing; continuing education (CEU) seminars for engineers and contractors; and a mission to deliver engineered geosynthetic solutions that strengthen, protect, and preserve global infrastructure through innovation, integrity, and sustainability.
